title: Cow waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='72' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e8e2f0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d8d0e4'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e8e2f0'/>
  <rect x='70' y='72' width='8' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d8d0e4'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b5a8a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6b5a8a'/>
  <rect x='70' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='58' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f0ecf6'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#8a76b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#8a76b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='48' rx='5' ry='5' fill='#8a76b0'/>
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='74' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#e8a8c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='30' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f0ecf6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='24' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8e2f0' transform='rotate(-25 32 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='24' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#e8e2f0' transform='rotate(25 76 24)'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M40 16 Q38 8 44 7' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 16 Q70 8 64 7' stroke='#c8b890' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='20' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#8a76b0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='38' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#f2c8d8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='38' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#a87898'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='38' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#a87898'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#4a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#4a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='26' r='1.2' fill='#f0ecf6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='26' r='1.2' fill='#f0ecf6'/>
  <!-- waving arm raised on right -->
  <path d='M78 52 Q88 44 86 30' stroke='#e8e2f0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='27' r='5' fill='#f0ecf6'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M28 54 Q20 58 18 64' stroke='#e8e2f0' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M82 56 Q90 60 88 70' stroke='#e8e2f0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='71' r='3' fill='#8a76b0'/>
</svg>
